summary: Examples of to_datetime: total seconds between dates, remaining seconds, days between dates, and comparing high-precision ISO8601 timestamps after trimming to microseconds.
questions: How do I get the number of days between two dates?
What is the default date format of to_datetime?
How do I compare .NET timestamps with 7 decimal places?
How do I get total seconds between two timestamps?

answer_card.title: to_datetime examples
answer_card.answer_md:
Default format is `%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S`.

```yaml
# total seconds
'{{ (("2016-08-14 20:00:12" | to_datetime) - ("2015-12-25" | to_datetime("%Y-%m-%d"))).total_seconds() }}'

# remaining seconds only (no days): 7212
'{{ (("2016-08-14 20:00:12" | to_datetime) - ("2016-08-14 18:00:00" | to_datetime)).seconds }}'

# days only
'{{ (("2016-08-14 20:00:12" | to_datetime) - ("2015-12-25" | to_datetime("%Y-%m-%d"))).days }}'
```

For timestamps more precise than microseconds, trim them with `regex_replace` first, then parse with `'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ'`.
